label: t02_01
text: The Pokémon Center is a great meet-up spot\nwhen you’re getting together with friends.

label: t02_03
text: *gulk gulk gulk gulk*\nAhhh! I’m all topped up!

label: t02_09
text: My Paralyze Heals were delivered! Oh, lovely!\nJust what you need to help a paralyzed Pokémon.

label: t02_10
text: The Pokémon at the head of your party will\nalways be the first one sent out in a battle.

label: t02_12
text:
That uniform tells me you’re a student at the
academy, no mistake about it.\c
You know you can have six Pokémon with you at
a time, don’t you? No need to skimp!

label: t02_13
text:
I go to school every day and learn lots and lots
’bout Pokémon and things!\c
Like, did you already know that every Pokémon
can remember up to four moves at a time?

label: t02_14
text:
Academy students who live here in Los Platos
don’t bother with the dorms. We commute to
school each day directly from home!\c
Though the hill does make it pretty rough.

label: t02_21
text: Have you heard that Pelipper can carry people’s\nletters and packages in its large bill?

label: t02_23
text: Off to school now, dear? Careful on the road,\nand remember to jot things down so you won’t\r\nforget what you’ve accomplished!

label: t02_24
text: This is Los Platos. We’re always happy to serve\nup a helping of hospitality to anyone passing by.
